guide.text: Harley Quinn dives into enemy lines for AoE damage. Damage Reduction against melee hits and Lifesteal let her deal heavy area damage while staying in the fight.
Increases Attack and Crit Rate, boosting Harley Quinn's sustained damage during [Self-Actualization] and helping her chain kills into her next Ultimate faster.
